article_title: AI 工程技能地图：用好编码 agent
core_theme: 用编码 agent 是一项核心 AI 工程技能：三步工作流（计划写规格 → 校准自主度执行与验证 → 部署与 agent 运维）加上五项支撑技能，长时自主运行的效用被高估
reader_takeaway: 看清工作流结构与五项技能，并知道自己该补哪一项
summary_angle: 一座哥特式走廊的三段结构：三座依次升高的尖拱舱室分别是计划、执行、部署监控，工程师在最高处俯瞰，agent 光点在结构中流动

Preserve one clear focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats in a wide 2.35:1 frame. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Simplify the background so that only the dark night and distant arch silhouettes remain as supporting context. Color palette: deep night black, candle amber, stone grey, restrained dark gold details.
